summary.text: James Gray is a Republican state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 6 since 2016 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He began serving as Senate president pro tempore in 2023 and previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Strafford 8 from 2012 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: In the 2025-2026 session Gray chairs the Senate Finance Committee and is vice chair of the Capital Budget Committee.
